value.rationale: The precise near-critical window is determined by the natural zero-central-Lyapunov phase boundary. The explicit nonconstant Gaussian crossover resolves how full-fiber ensemble synchronization changes across that boundary, a different measurable phenomenon from previously known correlation decay. Its neutral anomaly (mean width vanishing at n^{-1/2} despite infinitely many full-width revivals on almost every base orbit) has structural dynamical content; the entire continuum of eta is not an arbitrary narrow slice. Classical random-walk identities are recognized as proof ingredients rather than claimed independent discoveries.
